panels.description: This shows each graphics card's busy percentage, reported by the card monitor. Use should rise during work and fall at idle; a card staying busy while requests wait can mean overload. Check docs/runbooks/observability.md §4.
panels.title: GPU utilisation

panels.description: This shows used and free memory on each graphics card, reported by the card monitor. Free space should remain available; very little free space can prevent the engine from serving work. Check docs/runbooks/observability.md §4.
panels.title: GPU memory

panels.description: This shows each graphics card's temperature, reported by the card monitor. A steady temperature during normal work is expected; a sustained rise can point to cooling trouble. Check docs/runbooks/observability.md §4.
panels.title: GPU temperature

panels.description: This shows each graphics card's power use, reported by the card monitor. It normally rises with work and falls at idle; an unusual sustained value calls for a check of the engine and card. Check docs/runbooks/observability.md §4.
panels.title: GPU power

panels.description: This shows the graphics driver version reported by each card. It should match the tested version in this release; a mismatch raises the driver-drift page. Follow docs/runbooks/observability.md §4.
panels.title: Driver version

panels.description: This shows how full the engine's memory for active requests is, from the engine's own measurements. Lower use leaves room for more requests; a level near full with waiting requests signals capacity pressure. Check docs/runbooks/observability.md §4.
panels.title: KV-cache usage

panels.description: This shows how many requests the engine is running and how many are waiting, from the engine's own measurements. A short wait during a burst is expected; a queue that keeps growing means requests are not being served promptly. Check docs/runbooks/observability.md §4.
panels.title: Queue depth
